This Philadelphia cream cheese on pasta thing is really good. I learned about it from the Pasta Grammar YouTube channel. It turns out, this is extremely popular in Italy. In fact, nobody in Italy knows what cream cheese is. Everybody knows it as Philadelphia.
An important tip: It's far better to first mix the Philadelphia Cream Cheese with a bit of pasta water to create a more sauce-like consistency, then mix in the pasta. This will work far better than trying to mix the Philadelphia into the pasta.
